name: clinicflow
description: ClinicFlow — gestion des patients et rendez-vous (PERN)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @clinicflow/shared" "npm run dev -w @clinicflow/api" "npm run dev -w @clinicflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @clinicflow/api && npm run build -w @clinicflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
